programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: It's always a busy day at Gecko's Garage! The fun starts when Fiona the Fire Truck arrives with a broken hose that needs a clever fix. Then, Baby Truck comes in after playing in muddy puddles and needs a trip through the car wash machine. The day gets even busier with a late-night emergency wheel change for Bobby, which Gecko must do without waking up the sleeping Mechanicals! Plus, the Mechs have to work as a team when Gecko is feeling unwell.

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Grandma Gecko is here to help with some epic rescues! The action starts when Weasel's accelerator gets stuck and he can't stop driving! Grandma Gecko and Gecko hop on a motorbike for a high-speed chase to save him. Then, when lots of vehicles get flat tires from nails on the road, Gecko feels the pressure and calls his Grandma to help him speedily change all the tires. From building a wind turbine to saving Blue, Grandma can do it all!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi and Meekah for an Adventurous August jam session! First, explore the science of racing and climbing at the Discovery Cube. Then, discover rhythm and percussion and put on a rockin' show you won't want to miss.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Embark on a creative quest for Adventurous August! Join Blippi and Meekah at a castle to learn what it's like to be a medieval knight. Then, head to Cr8Space for a day of painting, drawing, and imaginative summer fun.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's a grand Adventurous August finale! Join Meekah for a game of hide-and-seek in a museum, where she'll report the news. Then, team up with Blippi at a waterpark to follow a real treasure map to a hidden prize!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! This gives her a great idea to use her Wonder Watch to shrink the trucks and have her own mini Jam. Then, it's a dancing scavenger hunt as Meekah digs her way around a construction site to see her favorite trucks on the move. As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are on the case, solving the biggest mysteries in town! When Aunt Augustine's new necklace is stolen, Detective Mila and Morphle find clues to track down the culprits. Then, Winston and the Bandits steal a time machine and use it to go to the future! Mila and Morphle must follow them to get it back. The mysteries continue as the Bandits steal Morphle and the friends must find him, and a body swap device causes a confusing mix-up!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Welcome to the wacky world of Winston and Orphle! First, Winston tricks a Magic Pet into growing his robots of Mila and Morphle big enough to steal the entire Magic Pet Center! Then, Orphle causes trouble on his own when he runs away with the cake Mila made for her and Morphle's Matchiversary. The two troublemakers team up to try and get their hands on a special surprise gift, but it's up to Mila and Morphle to stop them!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Have a giant Adventurous August! Help the Oddbods shrink a giant Zee back to normal size, join Jeff's obsessive quest to find out who stole his straw, and watch as Newt agrees to go skydiving to complete her sticker collection!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are taking on some new roles! First, Fuse chops down a tree and finds himself the reluctant parent to a hatchling chick. Will the cute baby bird melt his heart? Then, as a stickler for the rules, Jeff is appointed warden for the cul-de-sac, but he soon gets a taste for his newfound power! Plus, a mysterious UFO keeps stealing cows from nearby fields, and Bubbles goes to investigate.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: Suspended from the team, Shakes uses the time off to investigate his father's disappearance on Mt. Kilimanjaro. While evading a mad snowboarder and an avalanche, Shakes can't help but monitor his teammates' every move from afar.

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: In a last-ditch effort to stay in the running for the final, Coach drops his team in the Amazon for some wild training. Shakes is amped, but El Matador isn't himself. Who is he?! And what does a mysterious photographer have to do with it?

programme.title: Supa Strikas: Rookie Season
programme.desc: All set to play Iron Tank for a place in the final, Supa Strikas can't resist a no-rules pick-up game aboard a massive tanker. But when an uninvited guest steers the ship towards disaster, will they rise above rivalry and work together?

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Create your own world this Adventurous August! First, join Blippi at an imagination museum to build an entire miniature town. Then, become a reporter in Hawaii to discover exciting jobs like being a firefighter or a TV anchor!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Go on a brilliant quest for Adventurous August! Join Blippi and Meekah at the Color Factory to explore amazing art displays. Then, head to the MOXI museum to learn all about the science of sound, light, and technology.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Find the colors of Adventurous August! Join Meekah on a hunt to fill her Rainbow Bingo card at a fun play place. Then, learn all about her daily routines that help prepare for a day of adventure and a good night's sleep.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: It's Monster Jammin time with Meekah! First, she watches a skid steer challenge a monster truck to a donut challenge! As she follows Blippi's construction truck map, she creates a dance by watching each vehicle work.

programme.title: Air Asia Buds Adventures
programme.desc: It's time for a high-flying adventure with the Air Asia Buds! Join them as they explore a busy fire station, visit a fun-filled farm, and learn all about amazing animals. Their journey takes them to incredible destinations around the world, from the vibrant streets of Bangkok and the beautiful beaches of the Philippines to the bustling city of Kuala Lumpur. It's a non-stop trip full of fun, learning, and discovery.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Oddbods

Thousands of question marks arise in Ameera's mind, more so when she discovers the meaning of Tutuge.

The staff in the building she woke up in claims that she is in a hospital recovering from her amnesia. But there is something odd with how every girl she meets is named Anne and something sinister roams the building every night. Now, she must quickly figure out how to survive and escape from her predicament.

When she tries to help the owner of a huanted hotel to set captive spirits free, she finds out the truth about a gruesome murder in one of the rooms. Finally in 'The Book of Truth', Jess, a horror writer, receives a mysterious e-mail about the strange curse of ancient scripts engraved on palm leaves. Everything written on the leaves will become true.

programme.title: Anguish

She's been diagnosed with an assortment of mental ailments since her mother discovered her at a young age gruesomely banging her head against a wall. Now Tess's new medication seems to be working as she and her mother move to a new town seeking a fresh start. As Tess adjusts to her new life, horrific visions begin appearing of a deceased local girl, Lucy, recently killed in a grisly car accident. Hallucinations and physical manifestations intensify as Lucy's haunted spirit inhabits Tess's mind, body and soul. A local priest fears that it is Lucy attempting to return by taking control of the troubled Tess, and suggests exorcism as the only way to drive the dead girl out and bring peace to both of these tortured young souls.
